placements.why: The content establishes an organizational category for operational readiness — the practice of rehearsing procedures to convert them from documented steps into real capabilities. No existing strata covers this domain.
placements.title: From documented procedure to practiced capability
placements.theme: Operational readiness is earned through rehearsal, not declared by documentation.

placements.title: Rehearsal transforms rollback from procedure to capability
placements.theme: An unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all — rehearsal is what makes an operational procedure into an operational capability.
placements.why: src-2 asserts that rehearsal is constitutive of rollback capability (not optional), and src-1 operationalizes that conviction as a monthly directive. Together they name a thematic subject — the relationship between rehearsal and capability — that future envelopes can keep feeding.
